items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Klage beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg, Jägerstraße 1, 59821 Musterarnsberg, erhoben werden; ein Widerspruchsverfahren findet nicht statt.
items.computation: The letter carries two dates: the Bescheid itself is dated 18.11.2026, while the letterhead 'Datum' field (normally the posting date) shows 20.11.2026. This is a general municipal authority (Bauordnung of Stadt Beispielhagen, NRW), not a tax office, so the 4-day delivery fiction applies and the delivery day is NOT shifted even if it falls on a weekend (per the rule for general authorities). Using the earliest plausible posting date (18.11.2026, a Wednesday) per the rule to prefer the earliest plausible date when the letter is internally inconsistent about its date: day 1=19.11(Thu), day2=20.11(Fri), day3=21.11(Sat), day4=22.11(Sun) -> deemed delivered Sun 22.11.2026 (not moved, general authority). One month after delivery ends, per §188 Abs.2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 22.12.2026 (Tuesday), which is a normal working day in NRW (no holiday), so no further shift is needed. (If the later printed date 20.11.2026 were instead the posting date, delivery would be Tue 24.11.2026 and the deadline would be Thu 24.12.2026 instead — two days later.)
